about: REAL frames recorded by DIRECTOR-2 (offline, $0) for Director P4-7c (!611, branch seat2/director-p4-7c-matcher-v2, head ab236ac0c494, stacked on !607), from streams/director2/p4-7-template-match/out/ (p47c/record.py): M6 (scenario-M6-assignment.json) and M7 (scenario-M7-mixed.json). Extracted mechanically, nothing edited, the same way as M0-M5 in frames.json: every frame of direction 'in' (what Studio sends to Director) and every Director frame of type 'template_match', in recorded order, verbatim. The plan card sends ONE frame (the deck decision only: slides[] empty, no assignment); the strawman sends a SECOND frame with slides[], deck[i].slides and assignment[] (Composer's mix-and-match plan). Ids and timestamps are masked by the recorder. readme_p47c_sha256 is the README.md of that folder when M6 / M7 were extracted. The proof (scripts/test-studio-template-match-p47c.mjs) pins each recording's sha256 and size and compares this file with the originals when they are on disk.
